description: Schema for the GitLab SAST scan profile configuration

secure_analyzers_prefix.description: Prefix for the container registry from which the analyzer image is pulled.

image_suffix.description: Suffix appended to the analyzer image name.

analyzer_image_tag.description: Tag of the analyzer image to use. Warning: Setting this value overrides the pinned image tag for all SAST analyzers, which can cause analyzer failures if they require specific versions.

excluded_paths.description: Glob paths excluded from the scan.

advanced_sast_partial_scan.description: Controls GitLab Advanced SAST diff-based scanning. Use 'differential' to enable, 'false' to disable.

gitlab_adv_sast_incr_scan.description: Whether GitLab Advanced SAST incremental scanning is enabled.
